- Introducing Intuit Foresight


Intuit Foresight is a new home for AI innovations at Inuit. A dedicated destination where you can discover, learn and experience the latest AI technologies.


Whether you are a small business owner looking for new ways to move your business forward, curious about the new AI capabilities, or just interested in the future of AI, Foresight offers everything you are looking for. ****


## **Today, Foresight brings together two experiences: Explainers and Experiments.**


**Explainers** provide in-depth breakdowns of the scientific concepts and technical logic behind the products and use cases, through clear language, storytelling, visuals and interactive experiences. **Experiments** are early-stage, hands-on tools for small businesses that you can try today by creating an account.


## **Try an Explainer Today: AI Science Made Simple**


Our featured explainer, **REMem: Episodic Memory for AI Agents** for example, imagine asking an AI assistant, “What happened the last time I had a similar problem?” or “which customer issue came up first?” Many AI memory systems retrieve information by finding content that’s similar to your question. But remembering relevant details isn’t the same as understanding the sequence of events, how they’re connected or what changed over time.


That’s the challenge episodic memory aims to address. It organizes information around events and their relationships, giving AI agents a more structured way to revisit past interactions and reasons.


As the AI agents take on more complex tasks, the ability to understand the past events and their context could help the AI agent become smarter and deliver more relevant, personalized assistance.


Read the full explainer[here](https://www.intuit.com/foresight/explained/remem-episodic-memory-ai-agents)


### **Try a Live Experiment Today: AI Business Advisor**


At Intuit, we’re constantly thinking about how AI can help to solve meaningful challenges for consumers and businesses. AI Business Advisor is an interactive tool designed to help business owners explore new ideas, discover potential opportunities, and find inspiration for the next business move.


Through this experiment, you can experience how AI technology could assist you to think differently, gain new perspectives for your business. Whether you are thinking of growing your business, navigating a challenge, or just simply wondering what AI could support your entrepreneurial goals. AI Business Advisor is the place to pause, rethink and reimagine the possibilities for your next business move.


[Try AI Business Advisor](https://delphi.intuit.com/delphi-ai-ui/guest?entry_point=foresight_experiment_cards_business_advisor_cta&ref_session_id=c0325d0c-6c1c-4b32-a69f-1b95bdcd3c07&utm_source=foresight&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=foresight_experiment_cards_business_advisor_cta&ref_ivid=896ac538-9db9-4075-90c0-de49a377dcac)
